claim.claim-text: 1. A refined fermented beverage having the following properties:
2. The refined fermented beverage according to claim 1, wherein the refined fermented beverage has no measurable protonated acetic acid and/or titratable acidity relative to acetic acid.

3. The refined fermented beverage according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the refined fermented beverage is a gluten-free, gluten-reduced, or gluten removed fermented beverage comprising gluten in a range of 0 ppm to 20 ppm of gluten, preferably 0 ppm of gluten.
4. The refined fermented beverage according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein the refined fermented beverage has an alcohol content from 0.05 percent by volume, up to about 65 percent by volume.
5. The refined fermented beverage according to any of claims 1 to 4, wherein the refined fermented beverage has an alcohol content from 4 percent by volume, up to about 20 percent by volume.
6. The refined fermented beverage according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein the refined fermented beverage has a trace amount of alcohol content of less than 0.05 percent by volume.
7. A neutralization system for reducing and removing acidic congeners in a fermented beverage, to produce a refined fermented beverage, comprising:

a) an in-line caustic dosing system configured to treat the fermented beverage by titrating or adding an alkaline treating agent to the fermented beverage to neutralize the organic acid congeners; and b) at least one separation apparatus configured to separate the neutralized organic acid congeners from the treated fermented beverage, thereby producing the refined fermented beverage.
8. An in-line caustic dosing system for neutralizing at least one organic acidic congener in a fermented beverage, the in-line caustic dosing system comprising:

9. The in-line caustic dosing system according to claim 8, comprising a pH meter upstream of the delivery of the alkaline treating agent and a pH meter downstream of the delivery of the alkaline treating agent into the fermented beverage stream.
10. A method for neutralizing at least one organic acidic congener in a fermented beverage solution according to the following steps:

11. A use of the neutralization system according to Claim 7 or of the in-line caustic dosing system according to Claim 8 or 9 to produce a refined fermented beverage having reduced or negligible levels of organic acidic congeners.

12. The use according to Claim 11, wherein a combined concentration of acetic acid and acetate within the refined fermented beverage is less than 400 ppm; and/or wherein a concentration of acetic acid within the refined fermented beverage is 10 to 100 ppm, preferably 25 to 75 ppm.
